data.name: Khatereh
data.gender_notes: Khatereh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'khaterah' meaning remembrance or reminder. In Islamic tradition, the name Khatereh is associated with remembering and honoring Allah. The name Khatereh carries the meaning “Remembrance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khatereh usually hope their child will grow to embody remembrance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that encourages the remembrance of Allah and the importance of spiritual practice in daily life.
data.etymology: Khatereh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Remembrance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khatereh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
